summary: i18n fix verification (v1.17.x translation audit fixes). NO crashes: 0 pageerrors / no red screen across 15 customer routes x 9 languages (ar,en,de,fr,zh,ja,hi,he,ru,th,ur) and 10 merchant routes (en+ar) incl. /merchant/live-preview. Verified FIXED: product/category names Arabic in ar on Home/Search/Cart/Favorites; Services tab service names Arabic in ar; Orders + Appearance screens fully translated in de/fr/zh/hi/he/ru/th/ur; no literal \n in services promo (all langs); Profile balance = Guthaben(de)/Solde(fr)/余额(zh)/יתרה(he); currency shows SAR in all non-Arabic langs; generated dict has 0 'ر.س' and 0 Arabic left in non-Arabic-script langs; days/time fixed (أحد→Sun/So./Вс, 12ص→12 AM). Language picker in Profile works end-to-end (ar→en→de→ar, persisted). Static audit: node scripts/audit_i18n.js → 0 missing and 0 \n in all 20 langs. Backend /api/translate + /bulk: 14/15 pytest pass (zh returned stale English cached value). REMAINING issues: many hardcoded strings still untranslated (Arabic literals rendered raw in checkout, returns, my-returns, rma-detail, my-services, service detail, shipping-matrix, roles/employees; hardcoded English in search/cart/favorites/product/home that shows in Arabic UI), raw payment_method codes on Orders, a few clear mistranslations ('الخط' (font)→'Line' in ALL 19 langs, 'طلب'→'Request', 'حديث تقني'→'Technical conversation'), and merchant Live Preview still shows Arabic product names in English mode. No deprecated Expo packages detected.

minor.issue: Stale bad cache: 'فرع جدة - التحلية' → zh returns 'Jeddah Branch - Al Thaliah' (English, cached:true). ROOT CAUSE: translate.py:_clean_ok() only rejects FOREIGN scripts; it never requires the TARGET script, so pure-Latin output is accepted & cached for zh/ja/ko/ru/he/hi/bn/th. DB translations_cache has 76 such rows (zh 2, he 10, ru 19, ja 16, ko 10, bn 5, th 14; most are brand names like WhatsApp which are OK, but some are real misses). Also cache hits are returned without re-validation.
If the retry also fails _clean_ok, the dirty first translation is still cached (translate.py:200-206). Should not cache / should return source.
Works (de: الرصيد→'Das Guthaben' — article included, minor; '99 ر.س'→'99 SAR'). es branch 'التحلية' → 'Al-Tihama' (wrong name, LLM quality).

Pre-existing, not in scope: CORS returns access-control-allow-origin '*' together with allow-credentials true; no brute-force lockout (6 wrong pw → still 401 and correct pw then 200); auth is token-based (no httpOnly auth cookie). bcrypt hash format $2b$ OK.
Server writes Arabic-only text: 'تم توصيل طلبك', 'طلب #.. - الحالة: delivered' (raw status), 'استرداد طلب إرجاع ...', 'استبدال نقاط بخصم 5.0 ر.س'. Shown in Arabic for all languages.

Status labels/descriptions rendered raw (Arabic in en/ja verified): app/my-returns.tsx:97,101; app/rma-detail.tsx:88,101; app/my-services.tsx:72,82,116; app/merchant/returns.tsx:130 (tabs 'الكل','بانتظار المراجعة','مقبولة','قيد الفحص','مكتملة','مرفوضة'),165. translate.py: make _clean_ok require at least one char of the target script for non-Latin targets (zh/ja/ko/ru/he/hi/bn/th, allowing brand-only strings), don't cache when retry fails, and purge bad rows (e.g. zh 'فرع جدة - التحلية').
orders.tsx:40,59 double tSync (tSync(tSync(x, curLang()), lang)) sends already-translated text back to /api/translate as source 'ar' — remove inner tSync.
Make Orders filter row a horizontal ScrollView; fix 'delivered' icon.
Translate backend-generated notification/wallet/loyalty texts (or store keys) — currently Arabic for all languages.
critical_code_review_comments: useAutoT.tsx tSync fires background /api/translate for every cache miss including non-Arabic input (e.g. from nested tSync) — wasteful LLM calls.
translate.py cache lookup ignores source_lang; same Arabic text from different sources share cache (fine), but stale invalid entries are never revalidated.

~200 Arabic literals still sit in object props (label/title/name/time) across 30+ files (top: merchant/live-preview 34, roles 19, returns 14, rma-detail 13, MerchantSocialFeed 9, shipping-matrix 9, product-form 9) — many rendered without tSync.
Pre-existing 70 tsc errors unchanged; none are 'lang'/'curLang' related.
